sentences.quote: Fernando Fernandez (born 1966) is an Argentine business executive who has been chief executive officer (CEO) of Unilever since March 2025, succeeding Hein Schumacher.
sentences.text: Fernando Fernandez, born in 1966 in Argentina, has been chief executive officer of Unilever since March 2025, succeeding Hein Schumacher.
He studied economics at the University of Buenos Aires and has spent more than 37 years at Unilever, working across areas from supply chain to the C-suite.
He was Chief Financial Officer from January 2024, and before that President of Beauty & Wellbeing, having also served as President Latin America, CEO Brazil and CEO Philippines.
As CEO he leads a consumer goods business present in 190 countries serving 3.7 billion people daily.
He has said the focus will be on building a future-fit portfolio and delivering superiority across the top 30 power brands.

citations.title: 2026 First Half Results

sentences.text: Unilever PLC has concentrated its portfolio behind 30 Power Brands, which generate 78% of turnover and are the brands with global scale and premium potential that receive its best innovation, marketing and technology, and these brands grew underlying sales 6.0% in the first half of 2026, including 5.4% volume growth.

sentences.quote: Underlying sales growth (USG) in the first half was 4.8%, with 4.2% from volume and 0.6% from price
sentences.text: Growth is volume-led: first-half 2026 underlying sales rose 4.8%, with 4.2% from volume and 0.6% from price, and the 2026 outlook was upgraded to underlying sales growth within the 4% to 6% multi-year range.

sentences.quote: Underlying operating margin was up 10bps at 20.3%, with healthy gross margins of 46.8% and continued competitive investment behind our brands at 16.1% of turnover.
sentences.text: Margins are being supported by productivity, with underlying operating margin up 10 basis points to 20.3% while brand and marketing investment stayed at 16.1% of turnover and an 800 million euro productivity programme completed ahead of schedule.

sentences.quote: Emerging markets showed momentum - India, Indonesia and Latin America all delivered strong growth - while North America again outperformed its market.
sentences.text: Emerging markets add momentum, as India, Indonesia and Latin America all delivered strong growth while North America outperformed its market.

thesis_pillars.text: Growth is volume-led: first-half 2026 underlying sales rose 4.8%, with 4.2% from volume and 0.6% from price, and the 2026 outlook was upgraded to underlying sales growth within the 4% to 6% multi-year range. Margins are being supported by productivity, with underlying operating margin up 10 basis points to 20.3% while brand and marketing investment stayed at 16.1% of turnover and an 800 million euro productivity programme completed ahead of schedule. Emerging markets add momentum, as India, Indonesia and Latin America all delivered strong growth while North America outperformed its market.
